sources.title: (26.9)Ziggs Mid DEEP Explained Guide (MIND CONTROL HARD)

passive.name: Short Fuse
passive.text: Periodically, Ziggs' next basic attack deals bonus magic damage. This cooldown is reduced whenever Ziggs uses an ability.

spells.name: Bouncing Bomb
spells.text: Ziggs throws a bouncing bomb that deals magic damage.

spells.name: Satchel Charge
spells.text: Ziggs flings an explosive charge that detonates after a delay, or when this ability is activated again. The explosion deals magic damage to enemies, knocking them away. Ziggs is also knocked away, but takes no damage. Ziggs can use the Satchel to hexplode vulnerable enemy turrets.

spells.name: Hexplosive Minefield
spells.text: Ziggs scatters proximity mines that detonate on enemy contact, dealing magic damage and slowing. Successive mine detonations on the same target deal reduced damage.

spells.name: Mega Inferno Bomb
spells.text: Ziggs deploys his ultimate creation, the Mega Inferno Bomb, hurling it an enormous distance. Enemies in the primary blast zone take more damage than those farther away.

damage.value: Ziggs deals burst magic damage with his bombs, mines, and Satchel Charge.

archetype.value: Ziggs is a mage who attacks from range with explosives.

axis.value: Ziggs plays through wave control and poke rather than risky all-ins.

winCondition.value: Ziggs wins through pressure, positioning, and objective control.

bait.why: Ziggs cannot throw another Bouncing Bomb while it is on cooldown.
Ziggs cannot deploy another Mega Inferno Bomb during its long cooldown.

mistakes.value: Ziggs players risk losing their safety when they poke without using terrain and positioning.
